event.hall_dance.4.text: Same song, bigger room. One verse, then I step off again. My bow hand still hasn't heard.
event.hall_dance.4.why: remembers heart 10 instead of repeating its intro word for word

event.piper_heart10.outro.text: {if choice:chorus.home}They sang 'home' without me. All of them. I played one verse and put the bow down. ...So that's what quiet sounds like.{else}{if choice:chorus.road}They took the road and walked it without me. I stood there with my bow down. Best seat I've ever had.{else}The room sang itself back to the room. Even the good stool joined in. I only had to stand there.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_heart10.outro.why: matches the intro (she plays the first verse); road branch no longer echoes heart 6's 'not so bad'

event.piper_birthday.intro.text: My birthday! I wrote myself a song. It's a very modest masterpiece. You'll want a good seat.
event.piper_birthday.intro.why: no longer says 'front row' right before the shipped 'Front row's yours'

dlg.piper.birthday.r0.text: Happy birthday to me, from you! Short, sweet, and in tune. It's going in the encore.
dlg.piper.birthday.r0.why: 'That's a chorus' was used four times; kept it for rarer beats

event.piper_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.piper.wish}Your wish made the encore. I rhymed 'birthday' with 'worth the day'. Don't check.{else}{if choice:bday.piper.sing}My song, your voice, and the room clapped for you. I'm only a tiny bit jealous.{else}A song's coming with your name in it. Don't ask when. It will rhyme. Eventually.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_birthday.after.why: wish branch no longer repeats r0's encore line or the squint tic

event.story_band_battle.after.text: {if choice:band.piper}The fiddle wins! Juno took it beautifully. She's already forging a louder anvil.{else}{if choice:band.juno}The forge band wins! I'm thrilled. I'm furious. I'm writing a song about both.{else}A joint set! Fiddle, anvils, and a whole square clapping on the beat. Mostly on the beat.{/if}{/if}

event.piper_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.piper.yes}Finally! That love song's been in the case since you said 'a verse or two'. Tonight it comes out.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.piper.friends}Friends, then. Good. Some songs are better as duets. I'm keeping the second verse anyway.{else}Still a verse or two? Then the last line stays blank. Some songs end better late.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_courtship2.after.why: remembers the first answer; no second 'You'll hear it Friday'

event.piper_partners.intro.text: Hey, you. Front row. I wrote you a song, and it's the first one I haven't hidden behind a joke. Mostly.

event.overheard_wren_piper_2.l2.text: Wren! You wrote a verse? Read it! No, sing it! No, read it slowly!
event.overheard_wren_piper_2.l2.why: saves the crying joke for 'The Headliner', where Wren answers it

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l4.text: Pencil it is. Somebody keeps fixing my pencil anyway. Save me the last glass.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l4.why: can play before Pencil Rhymes, so she no longer names Hazel; leaves the lyric thread instead

threads.piper_heart2: The second chord, Friday: what she teaches next.
threads.piper_heart5: Four notes she hums alone and does not know the source of.

threads.piper_heart6: She went up; will she ever get the song they sing without her?
threads.piper_heart8: A chorus waiting for a room to sing it without her.
threads.piper_heart10: The village knows the song; what does Piper write next, now she can rest?

notes: piper_heart10: heart 4 promises the request comes back. The outro branches only on chorus; please honor choice.request.* in heart 10 (e.g. a short opening tag line) as the r2 brief says.
hall_dance and piper_heart10 cue music 'piper_theme', which is not in the music cue list; both will play silent. heart10 also plays sfx 'coin' during the song; 'bell' or nothing fits better.
overheard_hazel_piper_2: Hazel says she watches Piper 'every Thursday' at the library's back corner; Piper's schedule puts her at the beach mornings and saloon evenings. Hazel may want to check it.
'That's a chorus' now appears in piper_friend.wrap and overheard_piper_juno_2.l3 only; 'if you squint' in piper_friend.doing and piper_heart8 r1 only.
